# Loca Deserta (Дике Поле)

> Loca Deserta (Ukrainian: «Дике Поле», "Wild Field") is an independent Ukrainian game and military sci-fi book universe by game developer and author Dmytro Gladkyi (Дмитро Гладкий, @dmytrogladkyi). It is the most active modern developer of games about Ukrainian Cossacks: 10 Cossack-era games since 2019 (3 of them in development now) in 10 genres (SICHA: Cossack Combat — pixel-art sabre duels, Eastern Wars — real-time tactics of Khmelnytsky's war, Valka: The Salt Road — chumak caravan defence, Odesa, Sloboda, Sloboda 2, Chumaki, Hex, Interactive Stories), a Roblox game, and the «Зоряний Гетьманат» (Star Hetmanate) sci-fi novel series.

The universe spans two eras:

- **Historical Cossack era**: games set in the Ukrainian Wild Field, the Zaporozhian Sich and Khadjibey (Odesa) during the 16th–17th centuries.
- **Loca Deserta Sci-Fi** («Дике Поле Sci-Fi»): an alternate history where Hetman Ivan Vyhovskyi preserved the Cossack Hetmanate in 1657, which grows into the interstellar Hetmanate Federation with its capital Star Sich in the Virgo Supercluster (25th century, Star Era 281 = 2424 AD).

The website is bilingual: English at https://locadeserta.com/ and Ukrainian at https://locadeserta.com/uk/. The books are written in Ukrainian.

## Games

- [SICHA — Cossack Combat](https://sicha.locadeserta.com/): Pixel-art sabre duels from the age of the Cossacks. 35 heroes of the Hetmanate, the Commonwealth, the Ottomans and the Crimean Tatars, 12 combos, dozens of sabres, the Cossack's Path campaign and Wi-Fi duels with a friend. Coming soon to Android and iOS, then Steam. Platforms: Android (Soon), iOS (Soon), Steam (Soon).
- [Valka: The Salt Road](https://valka.locadeserta.com/): A side-view pixel-art caravan defence game in the spirit of Kingdom Two Crowns. Lead a Cossack salt caravan 1,130 km from Kerch to Kyiv: trade and hire guards by day, defend the icon of the Pokrova from Ukrainian folklore creatures by night. 50 nights, a boss every 5th. Android first, then iOS. Platforms: Android (Soon), iOS (Soon).
- [Eastern Wars](https://ew.locadeserta.com/): Real-time tactics in the battles of Khmelnytsky's war, 1648–1655. Command regiments of the Cossack Hetmanate, the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Ottoman Empire, where terrain and morale decide the fight: a 12-battle campaign from Zhovti Vody to Okhmativ, skirmishes and two-phone battles over Wi-Fi. Coming soon to Google Play. Platforms: Android (Soon).
- [Loca Deserta: Settlers](https://settlers.locadeserta.com): A macro-economic space colony builder inspired by The Settlers III/IV set in the Loca Deserta Sci-Fi universe. Harvest asteroids, chain production buildings, expand territory with Towers, and colonise planets named after Ukrainian regions — Podillia, Zhovti Vody, Kryvbas. Free on Android phones and tablets, with an in-app purchase that unlocks the full game. Mobile only: pre-registration is open on Google Play; the App Store follows. Platforms: Android (Free, Pre-registration), iOS (Coming Soon).
- [Loca Deserta: Odesa](https://locadeserta.com/odesa/): Settle the south of Ukraine in Khadjibey-Odesa! Take on the role of a Cossack pioneer: complete 70+ interconnected quests, help Budjak Tatars and Cossack chieftains, dig up 5 ancient Ukrainian treasures, and enjoy 100% Ukrainian & English voice acting and songs. Platforms: Steam, Epic Games Store, iOS App Store, Google Play.
- [Loca Deserta: Sloboda 2](https://locadeserta.com/sloboda2/): A 3D low-poly settlement builder and production simulator set in the Zaporozhian Host. Start with an axe and pickaxe, construct 40+ buildings with 3 upgrade tiers, manage 14 production chains (from timber to cannons & ships), and unlock 6 valleys to the Black Sea. Platforms: Steam, iOS App Store, Google Play, Gamepad Support.
- [Loca Deserta: Chumaki](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertachumaki/index_en.html): Become a XVII-century Ukrainian Chumak salt-and-goods trader! Start at Zaporozhian Sich with one wagon, analyze market margins across 25+ historical towns (Chyhyryn, Kaniv, Cherkasy, Baturyn), hire Otamans, unlock trade perks, and build town manufactories. Platforms: Web Browser, Android, iOS, Windows, macOS.
- [Loca Deserta: Sloboda](https://locadeserta.com/citybuilding/index_en.html): The classic turn-and-season strategy game at the edge of the Great Meadow (Velykyi Luh). Manage workers, build smithies and powder cellars, train armed Cossacks, send aid to the central Sich server, and explore two handcrafted maps through changing seasons. Platforms: Web Browser, Android, iOS, Windows, Cross-Device Sync.
- [Loca Deserta: Interactive Stories](https://locadeserta.com/interactive/index_en.html): The game that started the universe! A series of branching historical interactive stories with 9+ adventures (Khotyn Night Raid, Escape after Cicora with 18 endings, Yellow Waters Ambush, Kodak Night) plus a built-in cross-platform Story Creator. Platforms: Web Browser, iOS App Store, Google Play.
- [Loca Deserta: Hex](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertahex/index_en.html): A tactical hexagonal puzzle and territory expansion game. Start from a single central hex, harvest free grain tiles, combine resources to recruit Cossacks, cannons, wagons, and boats, and break through the 15th-ring enemy fortress walls! Platforms: Web Browser, iOS App Store, Google Play.
- [Loca Deserta @ Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/games/105150009083536/Loca-Deserta-DEV-0-0-5): A team-based 20v20 multiplayer action shooter in Roblox! Cossacks vs. Tatars, objective-based warfare, weapon progression, custom skins, and the Assault on Kerch. Platforms: Roblox (PC, Mobile, Console).

## Books (Loca Deserta Sci-Fi series, in Ukrainian)

- [«Zoryanij Hetmanat» (Star Hetmanate) / «Зоряний Гетьманат»](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertascifi/books/Zoryanij_Getmanat.html): The foundational novel of Ukrainian military space sci-fi. In Star Era 281 (2424 AD), the Hetmanate Federation establishes secret colony "Wild Field 17" guarded by three regiments of Space Haiduks. In SE 323, all contact with the colony is lost...
- [«Zustrich v Stepu» (Encounter in the Steppe) / «Зустріч в Степу»](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertascifi/books/Zustrich_v_Stepu.html): Planet Wild Field-17. Otaman Bohdan Tytar leads three Plastun scouts on bot-horses armed with a heavy "Hornet" flamethrower deep behind Empire of the Sun lines to destroy an enemy melta-convoy.
- [«Vistrya Kulaku» (Fist’s Edge) / «Вістря Кулаку»](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertascifi/books/Vistrya_Kulaku.html): When elite Samanaks of the Empire of the Sun seize a warp station on an abandoned moon, 2nd-grade Terminator Ivan Donets and the Hetmanate assault regiment launch an orbital drop into a plasma-scorched labyrinth.
- [Loca Deserta Sci-Fi hub](https://locadeserta.com/locadesertascifi/index_en.html): overview of the sci-fi universe, timeline and all books.
- [Sci-Fi lore wiki](https://scifi.locadeserta.com/): factions, history and technology of the sci-fi universe.

## Play in the browser

- [Loca Deserta: Sloboda](https://locadeserta.com/sloboda/): Cossack settlement strategy game.
- [Loca Deserta: Chumaki](https://locadeserta.com/chumaki/): XVII-century trading simulator.
- [Loca Deserta: Interactive Stories](https://locadeserta.com/game/?lang=en): branching historical stories.
- [Loca Deserta: Hex](https://locadeserta.com/hex/): hexagonal strategy puzzle.
